blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate of the Philippines and the Intercontinental Broadcasting Corporation (IBC-13) on Tuesday launched Senate TV, a channel dedicated to broadcasting the upper chamber’s proceedings. In a speech during the channel’s launch, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said that Senate TV will give Filipinos better access to information about Senate affairs. READ: Senate
